title: FICAug: Feature-Informed Clustering and Augmentation for Facial-Expression-Based Parkinson's Disease Screening
abstract: arXiv:2409.17685v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Hypomimia has drawn growing interest as a digital marker for screening Parkinson's disease (PD). However, developing reliable facial-expression-based screening models is challenging because clinical PD datasets are small, exposing models to only a narrow range of how hypomimia can appear across individuals. Standard augmentation strategies do not solve this problem; recombining or perturbing existing samples produces variation, but not new facial configurations that are plausible and clinically meaningful. We introduce FICAug to address this gap. The framework clusters Action Unit (AU) feature vectors extracted from facial expression images, discards clusters that mix labels inconsistently, and generates synthetic AU vectors within the retained clusters with Gaussian sampling. translated_title: FICAug：面向基于面部表情的帕金森病筛查的特征信息聚类与增强方法
translated_abstract: 表情淡漠作为一种用于筛查帕金森病（PD）的数字标志物，引起了越来越多的关注。然而，开发可靠的基于面部表情的筛查模型极具挑战性，因为临床帕金森病数据集规模较小，导致模型只能接触到个体间表情淡漠表现的有限范围。标准的增强策略无法解决这一问题：对现有样本进行重新组合或扰动虽然能产生变化，但无法生成在临床上合理且具有意义的新面部表情结构。我们提出FICAug来填补这一空白。该框架对从面部表情图像中提取的动作单元（AU）特征向量进行聚类，丢弃标签混合不一致的聚类，并在保留的聚类内通过高斯采样生成合成AU向量。随后，GANimation将这些合成向量重建为逼真的面部图像。ResNet18模型在这些重建图像上进行预训练，然后再进行微调……
tldr: 本文提出FICAug框架，通过对面部动作单元特征进行聚类、丢弃标签不一致的聚类并在保留聚类内进行高斯采样生成合成样本，再借助GANimation重建为逼真面部图像用于模型预训练，从而解决临床数据稀缺问题并提升基于面部表情的帕金森病筛查效果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FICAug, a framework that clusters facial Action Unit features, discards label-inconsistent clusters, generates synthetic AU vectors via Gaussian sampling, and reconstructs them into realistic facial images with GANimation for model pretraining, addressing limited clinical data and improving facial-expression-based Parkinson's disease screening.
